name: Counting Out Time
summary: Chromie asks you to recover Andorhal Watches from the rubble of Andorhal. They are to be returned to her at the Andorhal Inn in the Western Plaguelands.

sections.title: Among the Rubble
sections.body: At the Andorhal Inn in the Western Plaguelands, Chromie asks you to search the ruined city for Andorhal Watches. She needs five brought back to her.

faq.q: Who is asking for Andorhal Watches?
faq.answer: Chromie asks you to find Andorhal Watches among the rubble of the city.

faq.q: Where do I find the watches?
faq.answer: The Andorhal Watches are among the rubble of Andorhal.

faq.q: How many Andorhal Watches does Chromie ask for?
faq.answer: Chromie asks you to bring back five Andorhal Watches.

faq.q: Where do I return the watches?
faq.answer: Return the Andorhal Watches to Chromie at the Andorhal Inn in the Western Plaguelands.
